description: Update non-chain-mapped OAuth2 client metadata (redirect/branding via treasury + sync-from-treasury)

parameters.name: redirect-uris
parameters.description: DEPRECATED — ignored if provided. Update redirect_url on treasury and run oauth2 client sync-from-treasury. CLI prints [WARNING] on stderr.
parameters.notes: Cannot change redirect via client update (API 0.1.0)

parameters.name: client-uri
parameters.description: DEPRECATED — ignored if provided. Set display_url at treasury create (--config) or on-chain, then sync-from-treasury.

parameters.name: logo-uri
parameters.description: DEPRECATED — ignored if provided. Set icon_url on treasury and run sync-from-treasury.

parameters.name: json-input
parameters.description: JSON file with full request body. Chain-mapped keys redirectUris, logoUri, clientUri are deprecated — stripped with [WARNING] on stderr.

validation_rules: Only the client owner can update
bindedTreasury cannot be modified after creation
Redirect/logo/client homepage must be changed on treasury, then sync-from-treasury — not via update
Deprecated chain-mapped flags/JSON keys are warn + discard before HTTP
If --json-input is provided, all other flags are ignored

errors.remediation: Only the client owner can update
Check the client ID — distinct from GET 403 access denial (EOAUTHCLIENT020)
Client may not exist or you lack access; re-auth with xion:mgr:read; do not assume wrong client ID from not-found wording

examples.description: Update client name and policy (non-chain-mapped fields)

examples.note: Do NOT use --redirect-uris or --logo-uri on update
